Check digital screens at station entrances for platform changes. Customers should board the first available train toward their destination and transfer if needed.   

For more information please visit TransLink.ca/railreplacement

Millennium Line and Canada Line are unaffected.

alerts.alertText: SkyTrain Expo Line elevator alert at 29th Avenue Station
alerts.header: Elevator at Expo Line 29th Avenue Station from 29th Ave entrance to the platform is temporarily out of service beginning Tue Sep 29 due to replacement.
alerts.description:
To increase accessibility between stations a special shuttle service called Accessible Shuttle will be implemented

This service will run between 29th and Joyce Stations on weekdays (excluding holidays) during peak hours to help customers connect between SkyTrain and bus services.

The shuttle will run approximately every 15 minutes on weekdays during the following hours (excluding holidays and weekends):
•	6 a.m. to 9 a.m.
•	3 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.

Customers traveling from 29th Avenue Station bus loop requiring access to SkyTrain can board the Accessible Shuttle from Bay 2 (Stop #51603) at 29th Avenue Station for a direct connection to Joyce–Collingwood Station and SkyTrain service during shuttle operating hours.

Customers traveling from Joyce–Collingwood Station SkyTrain to bus connections at 29th Avenue Station can board the Accessible Shuttle from Bay 8 (Stop 60285) located on the far-east side of the bus loop at Joyce–Collingwood Station for service to 29th Avenue Station and its bus connections during shuttle operating hours.

More information at TransLink.ca/elevators
